source.document: WHO SMART Guidelines — Antenatal Care (DAK L2)

regle_metier: Before each contact, during the Quick Check, the health worker should check whether the woman has any of the danger signs listed here – if yes, she should be referred to the hospital urgently; if no, the normal contact should be continued as normal

regles.annotation: If no danger signs are present, the health worker can continue with the normal ANC contact
regles.reference: Pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum and newborn care guide (IMPAC) (2015) (1)

regles.sortie: Follow-up steps/investigations: clinician's discretion for Central cyanosis
regles.action: Proceed with ANC contact OR  Referral for Central cyanosis
regles.annotation: Bluish discolouration around the mucous membranes in the mouth, lips and tongue.
regles.reference: Pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum and newborn care guide (IMPAC) (2015) (1)

regles.action: Proceed with ANC contact OR  Referral
